newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber trade dull, looks for direction.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber trade dull, looks for direction.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was dull by midsession on Tuesday with players looking for direction ahead of the afternoon session, dealers said.
"There's some open interest, but nothing was really done. We'll wait for leads in the afternoon. It's been a slow day so far," a trader said.
Traders said the major consumers were checking price levels but have not asked for offers so far.
"It's pretty much featureless this morning," one dealer said.
Most of the industry were away attending meetings of the International Rubber Study Group and the annual rubber trade forum in Liverpool.
Some dealers were also waiting for reports of any further purchases by the Thai government, which said it will spend one billion baht to prop up rubber prices.

At 0420 GMT, July RSS3 was indicated at 113.00-115.00 U.S. cents a kg from 115.25 cents. July RSS1 was indicated at 162.00 Singapore cents (US$1.13) a kg from 163.00 cents. July TSR20 was indicated at 149.00 Singapore cents (US$1.04) a kg from 149.25 cents. - (S$1.43 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
